title: Not Afraid
original_lyrics:
[intro]
( + )
Yeah, It's been ride...
I guess i had to go to that place to get to this one
Now some of you might still be in that place
If you're trying to get out, just follow me
I'll get you there
+
I'm not afraid to take stand
Gverybody come take my hand
We'll walk this road together, through the storm
+
Whatever weather, cold or warm
Just let you know that, you're not alone
Hola if you feel that you've been down the same road

[verse]
( + )
You can try and read my lyrics off of this paper before I lay '

[chorus]
When I say ' or do something I do it, I don't give damn
What you think, I'm doing this for me, so fuck the world
Feed it beans, it's gassed up, if thing's stopping me
I'mma be what I set out to be, without doubt undoubtedly

[chorus]
No if ands or buts don't try to ask him why or how can he
From Infinite down to the last Relapse album he's still shit and
Whether he's on salary, paid hourly
Until he bows out or he shit's his bowels out of him
Whichever comes first, for better or worse
He's married to the game, like fuck you for christmas
His gift is curse, forget the earth he's got the urge
To pull his dick from the dirt and fuck the universe
+
I'm not afraid to take stand
Gverybody come take my hand
We'll walk this road together, through the storm
+
Whatever weather, cold or warm
Just let you know that, you're not alone
Hola if you feel that you've been down the same road

[verse]
( + )
Ok quit playin' with the scissors and shit, and cut the crap
I shouldn't have to rhyme these words in the rhythm for you to know it's rap
You said you was king, you lied through your teeth
For that fuck your feelings, instead of getting crowned you're getting capped

[chorus]
I promise to never go back on that promise, in fact
Let's be honest, that last Relapse CF7+ was "ehhhh"
Perhaps I ran them accents into the ground
Relax, I ain't going back to that now

[chorus]
There's game called circle and I don't know how
I'm way too up to back down

[bridge]
Thought I had it mapped out but I guess I didn't
This fucking black cloud's still follow's me around

[bridge]
These motherfuckers are doing jumping jacks now!
+
I'm not afraid to take stand
Gverybody come take my hand
We'll walk this road together, through the storm
+
Whatever weather, cold or warm
Just let you know that, you're not alone
Hola if you feel that you've been down the same road

[chorus]
So starting today, I'm breaking out of this cage
I'm standing up, Imma face my demons
+
I'm manning up, Imma hold my ground
I've had enough, now I'm so fed up
Time to put my life back together right now

[verse]
( + )
It was my decision to get clean, I did it for me

[chorus]
So I could come back brand new me, you helped see me through

[chorus]
I been through the ringer, but they can do little to the middle finger
I think I got tear in my eye, I feel like the king of
My world, haters can make like bees with no stingers, and drop dead
No more beef flingers, no more drama from now on, I promise
To focus soley on handling my responsibility's as father
So I solemnly swear to always treat this roof like my daughters and raise it
You couldn't lift single shingle lonely

[chorus]
Put ??? and lift the whole liquor counter up

[bridge]
+
I'm not afraid to take stand
Gverybody come take my hand
We'll walk this road together, through the storm
+
Whatever weather, cold or warm
Just let you know that, you're not alone
Hola if you feel that you've been down the same road
